operations.status: DRAFT — unverified working transcription; not a complete standalone drawing or approval
operations.datum: Table X right, Y toward operator, Z up; CAD (X,-Y,Z). All regions are closed nominal bounds.
operations.source: Approved B26-build123d03 snapshot: SOURCE/models/enclosure/B26/BUILD123D03/b26_shell.py and b26_panels.py; SOURCE/source-manifest.json identifies exact source hashes. Companion enclosure_data.json includes source-derived schedules.

primitive_notation.box: box(x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1) is the table-coordinate axis-aligned solid over the listed intervals.
primitive_notation.cylinder: cylinder(x,y,z0,z1,r0,r1) is vertical at table (x,y), with bottom radius r0 and top radius r1. If r1 is absent it equals r0.
primitive_notation.section: section(x0,width,[(Y,Z),...]) is a closed polygon in table Y/Z extruded from x0 to x0+width. Listed polygons are ordered and closed back to the first point.

shell_base_operations: For each domain [x0,x1,y0,y1], start box(x0,x1,y0,y1,0,18) and subtract box(max(x0,2),min(x1,598),max(y0,2),min(y1,318),2,102).
For each rear shell y0=0, union box(max(x0,153.55),min(x1,446.45),0,2,18,23+80*sin(49 degrees)) when the X interval is positive.

For C01/C03/C04/C06 only, fillet the outside vertical corner R3 and inside vertical corner R1, before adding other features. Fillet the bottom exterior perimeter edges R0.8; apply only to external X=0/600 or Y=0/320 straight lines and their R3 corner arcs. Internal seam edges are not filleted.

C01: subtract box(37.25,72.15,-0.01,2.01,2,18); subtract two horizontal circular cuts radius1.8 at X32.75 and 76.65, Z9.95, with axes along table Y from -0.01 to 2.01. Subtract rear AC01 box defined by enclosure_data.json inlet_definition centre and width/height, table Y0..2.
C02: for each polygon_XZ in enclosure_data.json ventilation_cells_original, subtract the polygon extruded along table Y from -0.01 to 2.01.
C04: subtract horizontal circular cut radius3.1 on X101/Z10, axis table Y from 317.99 to 320.01.

Attach 33 posts from enclosure_data.json posts: union their foot and core, subtract their pilot, intersect with box(0,600,0,320,0,100), then intersect each post with each shell domain and union its intersecting piece to that shell.

For each of the 16 joints in enclosure_data.json joints, at offsets -9 and +9 along the normal axis union a pad cylinder(px,py,2,8,4.5), subtract its pilot cylinder(px,py,2.5,8.01,1.25), clip to each owning shell and attach.

For the 48 FIXED rows and E01-fixed_cage in enclosure_data.json controls, evaluate listed additive and subtractive local CSG primitives and local-to-table transform; intersect with each shell domain and attach. The 48 RETAINER rows and E01-body_retainer are separate printed parts. Fader end bosses/pilots and retainers already contain the B26-FADER-01 translation.

Device mount axes are in enclosure_data.json device_mount_axes_original_table_XY, with Y translation +20. At PI and DAC axes union cylinder(x,y,2,6,3.5); at PSU axes union cylinder(x,y,2,3,5). PI axes subtract cylinder(x,y,1,6.01,1); PSU axes subtract cylinder(x,y,-0.01,3.01,1.7) and frustum cylinder(x,y,0,1.3,3,1.7). DAC pads have no modeled retention holes.

For each jog centre (110,165) and (490,165), for angles 150,270,30 degrees take x=cx+31*cos(a), y=cy-31*sin(a). Union cylinder(x,y,2,8,5); subtract cylinder(x,y,-0.01,2.5,2.4) and cylinder(x,y,2.5,8.01,1.45).

For each jog centre and angles 60,180,300 degrees take x=cx+26.2*cos(a), y=cy-26.2*sin(a); union cylinder(x,y,2,3.5,1). Union an anti-rotation key defined in local CAD by box X24..26, Y-1..1, Z0..1; rotate +60 degrees about CAD Z and translate to (cx,-165,2).

operations: Let F=96+5/tan(49 degrees), J=96-80*cos(49 degrees), U=25+80*sin(49 degrees), CY=96-40*cos(49 degrees), H=23+40*sin(49 degrees). Angles in degrees.

For each half X=x0..x1, form section(x0,x1-x0,[(0,U-2),(J,U-2),(F,18),(F,20),(J,U),(0,U)]). Union the end-return section at X153.55..155.55 for left or X444.45..446.45 for right: [(2,18),(F,18),(F,20),(J,U),(2,U)].

Place display-plane cutters/features using CAD Plane origin (300,-CY,H), x_dir=(side,0,0), z_dir=(0,-sin49,cos49); local y_dir follows the right-handed frame. When side*row>0, reflect local geometry through XZ before placement. For the opening subtract the placed local box X[-136,136], Y[-36,36], Z[-5,5] with side=1,row=1.
For each X in 210,230,300,370,390 strictly inside the half X interval, subtract cylinder(X,4,U-2.01,U+0.01,1.7) and countersink frustum cylinder(X,4,U-1.3,U,1.7,3).

Left only: union box(325,345,13,29,U-10,U-2), then subtract pilot cylinders at (340,18) and (340,24) from Z=U-9 to U-1.99 radius1.25. Right only: subtract through cylinders at these axes from U-2.01 to U+0.01 radius1.7 and countersink frusta U-1.3..U radii1.7..3.

For row=-1,+1, construct local display support: union boxes X138.5..144.2 Y18..30 Z-21.2..0; X138.25..140 Y20..39.797470349551496 Z-21..-0.25; and X130..140 Y38.297470349551496..39.797470349551496 Z-21..-0.25. Subtract box X136..146 Y19.9..28.1 Z-21.2..-18 and local cylinders at (140.7,24), radius1.25 Z-18.1..-11 and radius4 Z-60..-21. Place with side=-1 for left or +1 for right and current row, then union.
Where present, fillet only the exterior top edge at Z=U R0.8. Do not fillet internal seams.

display_toes: Four separate printed display toes, one for each side=-1,+1 and row=-1,+1. In the display-plane local frame union box X136.5..144.2, Y20..28, Z-21..-18 and box X136.5..137.5, Y20..28, Z-18..-17. Subtract cylinder at local (140.7,24), radius1.7, Z-21.1..-17.9.

For each side,row, mirror the local toe through the local XZ plane when side*row>0; then place in the display frame specified in roof_parameters, origin (300,-CY,H), x_dir=(side,0,0), z_dir=(0,-sin49,cos49), H=23+40*sin49. This includes the B26 Z+5 displacement.
enclosure_fastener_references: The B26 model includes 197 nominal enclosure fastener references. They have no modeled threads or drive recesses; real purchased geometry and physical fit are not certified. Jog hardware is listed separately in the jog drawing. No U1-U4 mounting screws are specified.

Define local socket_screw(r,length,headR,headH) as a cylinder radius r over Z=-length..0 union a cylinder radius headR over Z=0..headH. Define local countersunk(r,length,headR) as a cylinder radius r over Z=-length..0 union a frustum from radius r at Z=-(headR-r) to headR at Z=0.
For each of the 16 C07 joints, at each pad axis +/-9 along the joint normal place socket_screw(1.5,8,2.75,3) at table (x,y), local Z0=global Z11. Quantity 32.

At each of the 28 flat-panel closure axes in the panel drawing place countersunk(1.5,8,3) with its top at global Z20. At five rear roof axes (X210/230/300/370/390,Y4) and two lap axes (340,18)/(340,24), use the same screw with top Z=25+80*sin(49 degrees). Quantity 35.
For the two PSU fasteners at X361.5/416.5, table Y54.35, place countersunk(1.5,6,3) in CAD frame origin (x,-54.35,0), x_dir=(1,0,0), z_dir=(0,0,-1). Quantity 2.

For each of the 49 removable control CSG groups in enclosure_data.json, inspect the listed subtractive primitives. Select every kind-1 frustum with unequal bottom and top radii and top radius 1.6 for P controls or 2.2 for all other controls. For local origin (u,v,w), size (r0,r1,h), and local-to-table transform M, place a screw at table x=M00*u+M01*v+M03, y=M10*u+M11*v+M13, global top z=M23+w+h. P controls use countersunk(0.8,5,1.6), four per control; B/T/F/E controls use countersunk(1,6,2.2), two per control. Quantity 124.

For each of four display toes, start with socket_screw(1.5,8,2.75,3) placed in local frame origin (140.7,24,-21), x_dir=(1,0,0), z_dir=(0,0,-1). Reflect this local shape through XZ if side*row>0, and place using the same display frame and side/row combinations defined in display_toes. Quantity 4.
Count: 32 joint + 35 closure + 2 PSU + 124 control + 4 display-toe = 197 enclosure fastener references.

schedules.datum: table X right, Y front, Z up; CAD=(X,-Y,Z)
schedules.scope: Derived fixed and retainer control primitive lists, panel post list, joint positions, device axes and ventilation source polygons only. No complete enclosure operations, no D02 roof, no sections or projections.
schedules.interpretation: CSG=[identifier,4x4 local-to-table transform, additive primitives, subtractive primitives]. Primitive=[kind,origin,size]; kind 0 is box with min corner and xyz size; kind 1 is vertical cone/frustum with bottom centre and [bottom radius,top radius,height]; kind 2 is vertical rounded rectangle with centre and [width,height,corner radius,extrusion height]. Union additive primitives, then subtract cuts in listed order; transform with local-to-table matrix; map table Y to negative CAD Y. The 48 groups named FIXED and E01-fixed_cage are attached to lower shells, clipped to shell XY boundaries. The 48 RETAINER groups and E01-body_retainer are separate parts; each fader retainer group contains two separate parts.

bridge.placement: for each joint centre, bottom Z=8; long direction X for normal X, Y for normal Y
